images.name: 余烬·处女
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four-color zodiac bow collection for a Skyrim SE mod, this sheet is VIRGO. Create one polished portrait 2:3 illustration with a complete tall bow on the LEFT, all tips and taut string visible, and one enlarged matching GRIP detail on the RIGHT. Calm near-black studio background. Strong, elegant, practical single-bow silhouette with continuous narrow ergonomic palm grip and arrow clearance. Entire bow made of solid magical LIGHT with broad colored planes and bright fluorescent bevel edges. Thick simple geometric strips, large open windows, precise layered shapes. Restrained bloom, preserve colored faces and edge readability. No metallic fittings, leather, wood, marble, realistic ice cracks, carved statues, woman, human, figurative wheat sculpture, animal, crown, lion mane, crab claws, six-point star, magic circle, arrow or background scenery. Abstract Virgo-inspired geometry: rhythm of grain, weaving, measured lattice, graceful ordered forms. Each weapon has a clearly individual center assembly, NOT repeated oval loops. Keep geometry modelable: few deliberate substantial shapes, no tiny filigree. A few small local particles near limb and shoulders suggest a draw effect, no giant aura. Exact Chinese title at bottom: "余烬·处女". Palette scarlet, crimson and rose-red. Design: geometric harvest. Broad elegant recurve spine with paired solid elongated rhombus plates arranged alternately like a stylized ear of grain, four pairs per limb, progressively tapering toward sharp tips. Plates lie swept ALONG the spine rather than radial spines or feathers. Large clean rhombus windows between selected pairs. Grip a straight hourglass prism bordered by two long tapered triangular recesses; upper/lower shoulders are angular open lozenge cradles with a single raised red prism spine, compact and refined rather than bulky. Glowing red planes, rose fine edges, NO realistic metal. Particle proposal: sparse rose-red rhombus motes and tiny triangular embers drifting along the grain pattern.
